# Section documentation for [STACK-Maxima](../index.md) /surds


---


## reroot(ex)<a id='reroot'></a>

Convert fractional powers to nth roots, using STACK's [`root`](#root) function in noun form.
For example, `reroot(x^(1/3)) = 'root(x,3)`.  Note the use of `'` to indicate a noun form.



| Argument name | type | description |
| ------------- | ---- | ----------- |
| expression | expression | subject of the function. |




| Return type | description |
| ----------- | ------------|
| expression | expression, re-rooted expression. |


---


## root([ex])<a id='root'></a>

Calculate the "nth" root of an expression.  Primarily used in a noun form, to create the correct latex.  Basically `root(ex1,ex2) = ex1^(1/ex2)`, and `root(ex1)=sqrt(ex1)`.
E.g. this is used to display things like `x^1/n` as \(\sqrt[n]{x}\) in LaTeX.



| Argument name | type | description |
| ------------- | ---- | ----------- |
| expression | expression | the expression we are taking the root of, and optionally the fractional power. |




| Return type | description |
| ----------- | ------------|
| expression | expression, value of the fractional power. |
